entities.label: Person
entities.summary: James Trick Jose was a Cornish rugby union player born in Falmouth who played for both Falmouth RFC and Devonport Albion. Jose gained 20 caps for Cornwall between 1904–11 and was a member of the famous 1908 County Championship winning side who beat Durham 17–3 at Redruth.
